en.disclaimer_text:
This technical diagnostic report (the Document) has been prepared by the consultant solely for the internal and exclusive use of the client organization on a strictly confidential basis. The Document constitutes a fast assessment exercise based exclusively on the information, explanations, and self-assessments provided by the client's staff during the technical interviews held, assuming their complete truthfulness, without any independent validation or field audit by our team. Consequently, the Document is delivered 'as is' (AS-IS) and does not constitute an explicit or implicit guarantee of performance, continuous security, or indemnification against operational or regulatory incidents.

Financial impact projections, actuarial risk simulations, and the values of Annual Loss Exposure (ALE) and worst-case (P90) calculated through the standard Open FAIR™ methodology and stochastic Monte Carlo models represent only statistical estimates and mathematical probability models based on uncertainty distributions. These monetary valuations constitute analytical tools exclusive to strategic prioritization of investments and cost of inaction (Business Case). Under no circumstances should they be interpreted, used, or assimilated as formal financial or accounting audits, provisions of accounting liabilities, guarantees of direct or indirect impact on the company's balance sheet, or as legally or judicially enforceable liabilities.

Any reference in the Document to standards, laws, regulations, or sector-specific compliance frameworks (such as the European NIS2 directive, the National Security Scheme ENS in its High Category, or PIC directives) is presented for strictly illustrative, technical, and engineering best practices purposes to mitigate risk exposure. These mentions do not constitute under any circumstances formal legal, regulatory, or tax advice. The interpretation, implementation, verification, and final compliance with applicable regulatory obligations and legal requirements rest strictly, directly, and non-transferably with the directors, legal advisors, compliance officers, and managers of the client organization.
